title: Hickory Dickory Dock: How Clocks Count Every Single Second!

lines.text: Hickory dickory dock, the mouse ran up the clock!
lines.caps: Hickory dickory *DOCK, | the mouse ran up the *CLOCK!

lines.text: The clock struck one, the mouse ran down, hickory dickory dock!
lines.caps: The clock struck *ONE, | the mouse ran down, hickory dickory *DOCK!

lines.text: Tick-tock, tick-tock! How does a clock measure every single second so accurately?
lines.caps: Tick-tock, *TICK-TOCK! | How does a clock measure every single second so *ACCURATELY?

lines.text: In big grandfather clocks, a swinging pendulum rocks steadily back and forth!
lines.caps: In big grandfather *CLOCKS, | a swinging pendulum rocks steadily back and *FORTH!

lines.text: Gravity ensures each swing takes the exact same fraction of a second!
lines.caps: Gravity ensures each *SWING | takes the exact same fraction of a *SECOND!

lines.text: An escapement gear catches and releases, making the famous tick-tock sound!
lines.caps: An escapement gear catches and *RELEASES, | making the famous tick-tock *SOUND!

lines.text: In modern digital watches, a tiny quartz crystal vibrates thirty-two thousand times a second!
lines.caps: In modern digital *WATCHES, | a tiny quartz crystal vibrates thirty-two thousand times a *SECOND!

lines.text: A microchip counts the vibrations and moves the hands forward right on time!
lines.caps: A microchip counts the *VIBRATIONS | and moves the hands forward right on *TIME!
